checks.run:
import importlib.util
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
root = Path.cwd()
package = types.ModuleType('factoryline')
package.__path__ = [str(root / 'factoryline')]
sys.modules['factoryline'] = package
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('factoryline.change_review', root / 'factoryline' / 'change_review.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules['factoryline.change_review'] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
with TemporaryDirectory() as value:
    result = module.review_change(Path(value), changed=['src/service.py'])
    assert result['schema'] == 'factory.change_review.v1'
    assert result['input_source'] == 'explicit'
    assert result['changed_paths'] == ['src/service.py']
    assert result['authority'] == {'execution': False, 'approval': False, 'publication': False, 'deployment': False, 'signing': False, 'messaging': False, 'credential': False, 'connector': False}
    assert len(result['review_sha256']) == 64
